Job Description JOB TITLE: Associate, Liquidity Pricing & Strategy LOCATION: London or Edinburgh SALARY: Competitive Package HOURS: Full-time WORKING PATTERN: Minimum two days per week or 40% of working hours in office/hub. The Role: The Liquidity Pricing & Strategy team is responsible for delivery of key Customer Deposits financial metrics by creating a pricing framework that enables growth but maintains discipline. Pricing strategy and governance is critical to ensuring strong client outcomes while maximising value from CIB customer deposits. The team play a vital role in supporting growth in the CIB client franchise by collaborating closely with teams across the Group including Sales, Coverage, Finance, Group Corporate Treasury, Balance Sheet Management and BCB. This role specifically will focus on supporting management of day-to-day pricing requests, pricing governance, delivering client and competitor pricing insights and improving processes that underpin the pricing framework. There will also be a strong focus on specialist liquidity products with a view to supporting growth in this key strategic segment. The role offers an excellent opportunity to develop a deep understanding of client liquidity needs, embed new tools and insights to drive growth, and play an important role in driving income initiatives for the Business. We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need. ​ We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes: A generous pension contribution of up to 15% An annual performance-related bonus Share schemes including free shares Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping 28 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies If you’re excited by the thought of becoming part of our team, get in touch. We’d love to hear from you! At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop. We keep your data safe. title: Financial Institution Financing Sales - VP
description: Financial Institution Financing Sales - VP Financial Markets is part of the ING Wholesale Bank, which represents all Corporate and Investment Banking activities of ING. We have a global footprint with local reach, deep sector expertise and we play a pivotal role in areas of sustainability and innovation. FM is the bank’s gateway to the professional markets around the world. In short, we assist our clients with investment and hedging risks by means of derivatives and we distribute bonds, loans, and equities towards investors. The client related business is supported by Trading, Structuring and Research expertise. Our main goal is to help our clients navigate the markets to position them for consistent and stable growth. Department Overview: Institutional Sales within Financial Markets provide both flow and bespoke financial solutions to clients. We are functionally structured to reflect the differing needs of our clients. This is enhanced with the specialist non-flow service from the Client Solutions Group. We transact and offer client solutions in a broad range of products including (among others) foreign exchange, interest rate derivatives, money markets, financing, primary and secondary fixed income and structured products. This structure enhances cross-selling, improves the flow of market/product information and aims to deepen client relationships through a platform capable of delivering a variety of products to a diverse client base. Our local footprint of circa 300 salespeople across 28 locations, ensures that sales teams are in close proximity to our clients, delivering global expertise with local insight. Main Duties and Responsibilities of Role: A public side financial market sales role focused on delivering Financing (Repo, Money Markets, broader financing such as securitised/structured products) to financial institutions in the UK, MENA and Switzerland. Sales coverage of existing clients, expansion of the Financing client base, and business growth in cooperation with colleagues across the European locations and globally. Active support to other London Salespeople Close collaboration with the eSales colleagues ranging from strategy to the transactional level FI clients include both hedgers and investors, such as regional and private banks, financial sponsors, insurance companies, traditional and alternative strategy asset managers, Real Money, Hedge Funds etc Strong Financing knowledge is critical for this position with a sophisticated customer base using both voice and electronic dealing streams. The candidate will need to play an active role in marketing and execution of this business Expert understanding of price creation and validation for all vanilla and exotic Financing products Responsibility for day-to-day new client onboarding for the FI team, working closely with the relationship managers and the Front Office Support teams to get all requirements in place in a timely and efficient manner Ongoing monitoring to ensure all upcoming CDD/KYC/EMIR/MIFID/DF expiries and requirements are managed to prevent any down time in client dealing ability Work closely with colleagues in Trading to ensure we optimise our capabilities and risk appetite Experience or familiarity with trade execution through relevant voice and e-Systems. Outstanding ability to focus on core issues and attention to detail with swift execution in a fast-paced environment Proactive role in the constructive feedback loop, aiming to continuously improve ING’s tools, methods and way-of-working Partner with Client Solutions Group and Research in distributing their content, publications and trade ideas How to succeed We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. Job Description JOB TITLE: Securitisation Lawyer - Securities & Asset Management Legal LOCATION(S): London, Bristol, Cardiff, Chester, Edinburgh, Halifax & Leeds HOURS: Full-time WORKING PATTERN: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of our time, at one of our office sites About this opportunity This is an excellent chance to join the Securities & Asset Management Legal team (SAML) in a permanent role. SAML brings together specialist lawyers working closely with the Global Markets business area for clients in the UK and overseas. The team supports business across a variety of debt capital markets transactions for its clients. Products include securitisations, unsecured primary bond issuance (IG/HY), private placements, social housing bonds and liability management exercises as well as other innovative capital markets products in the ESG, digital and PVLB spaces. We’re looking for a lawyer to support primarily on securitisation transactions involving various asset classes. These include mortgage loans, credit cards, auto loans and trade receivables. The role covers the structuring and development of transactions through to launch. You’ll also have the chance to learn about other types of debt capital markets transactions supported by the team, and to collaborate on initiatives with colleagues across Legal & Secretariat (L&S). Now is a superb time to join us, given this is a growing and strategic area for the Group and a market-leading business area. You would become part of a positive, encouraging and pragmatic legal team, reporting directly to the Head of Legal of SAML. As Lloyds Banking Group delivers its new Accelerate 2030 strategy, L&S has an important role to play in helping the business grow safely and sustainably, maintaining a strong people-centred culture and delivering better client outcomes through simplification, technology and innovation. If you’re searching for a great opportunity to continue building your knowledge and to develop your career, you can achieve these goals in this role. What you’ll be doing: Providing high-quality, pragmatic legal advice on a broad range of securitisation transactions, supporting the business from initial structuring discussions through to execution and post-closing activities. Advising on transactions across a range of asset classes, including residential mortgages, credit cards, auto loans and trade receivables, helping the business identify and manage legal and regulatory risks. Negotiating complex transaction documentation, working closely with internal stakeholders, external counsel, issuers and other market participants. Supporting the development and delivery of innovative funding and capital markets solutions, ensuring legal advice is aligned to commercial objectives and client outcomes. Building trusted relationships with colleagues across Global Markets, Risk, Compliance and Legal & Secretariat, acting as a valued adviser on strategic and day-to-day matters. Monitoring legal and regulatory developments affecting securitisation and debt capital markets products, providing clear guidance on potential impacts to the business. Contributing to wider Legal & Secretariat initiatives that enhance legal risk management, operational efficiency, knowledge sharing and colleague development. Why join us? We’re on an exciting journey to transform our Group and the way we’re shaping finance for good. We’re focusing on the future, investing in our technologies, workplaces, and colleagues to make our Group a great place for everyone. title: Praktikant Financial Market Sales (w/m/d)
description: Du hörst nie auf, neugierig zu sein, und willst jeden Tag dazulernen. Und das am liebsten von den Besten und mit den besten Aussichten. Du suchst die Herausforderung und möchtest endlich die Theorie Deines Studiums in die Praxis umsetzen. Genau das brauchst Du, um bei einem Praktikum bei uns richtig durchzustarten. Deine Aufgaben Du bist von Tag eins an direkt dabei und unterstützt unsere Profis bei der Betreuung deutscher und österreichischer Unternehmenskunden sowie institutioneller Kunden wie Banken, Fondsgesellschaften, Pensionskassen und Versicherungen. Du unterstützt aktiv die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Kapitalmarkttransaktionen (Anleiheemissionen). Risikomanagement und die Abwicklung von Handelsgeschäften sind dabei Deine größten Themen bei uns und Du analysierst mit neusten Analysetools das Geschäftstreiben. Du tauchst tief darin ein und kannst so Kundenbesuche sowie aktuelle Kapitalmarktthemen vor- und aufbereiten. Wenn Du Dich jetzt noch 1) für unser Produktspektrum aus Zins-, FX-, Rohstoff- und Aktien-Derivaten, Schuldscheinen sowie Anleihen in Primär- und Sekundärmarkt interessierst, 2) analysieren und präsentieren kannst und 3) gerne mit ING-Einheiten auf der ganzen Welt zusammenarbeiten möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Wir freuen uns auf Deinen Input! Dein Profil Immatrikuliert im Bachelor / Master in Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder im Gap Year zwischen Bachelor- und Master-Studium Nachweis über Kursbelegung in Finance mit Derivate Pricing-Bezug an der Hochschule Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Kapitalmarktprodukten und Bloomberg notwendig Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PowerPoint und Excel, insbesondere in der Erstellung professioneller Präsentation sowie der Analyse und Aufbereitung von Datensätzen Leidenschaft für die Entwicklungen an den Finanzmärkten Organisationstalent, hohe Leistungsbereitschaft & Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit & Sorgfalt Kommunikativer Teamplayer mit hoher Kundenorientierung Willen, die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch sind ein Muss Verfügbar für 6 Monate ab Oktober 2026 (bitte gib den genauen Zeitraum inkl. Startdatum im Anschreiben an) Freu Dich auf zahlreiche Benefits Ansprechende Vergütung, kostenloses Deutschlandticket, 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebsrestaurant Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe in einer Du-Kultur Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Zusätzlich zur Arbeit im Büro kannst Du auch mobil arbeiten – im Rahmen betrieblicher, gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen. Löwenstarke Netzwerkangebote, persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie vielfältige Angebote zu Bewegung, Vorsorge, Ernährung und Balance Lust auf einen neuen Job? Bei der ING sind wir bunt und vielfältig: unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten mit verschiedenen Perspektiven - in einer internationalen Kultur, in der wir uns wertschätzen. Dabei tragen wir Sneaker und Pumps, Hoodies und Anzüge. Weil Menschen nicht in Schubladen passen. Na, wie wärs? Bewirb Dich einfach online bei uns – am schnellsten geht´s, wenn Du Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse schon parat hast.

title: Financial Risk Specialist – Market & Liquidity Risk Management (w/m/d)
description: You feel at home in capital markets and thrive in intelligent risk management as well as quantitative analyses? Do you want to support our decision making using state-of-the-art models and data while working in an international and agile environment? Is a corporate culture that encourages personal responsibility, rewards performance and offers opportunities for continuous development right up your alley? Then apply now with your CV – your team is excited to meet you. Your Tasks You analyse and quantify market and liquidity risks across all our business activities – from Retail and Wholesale Banking to Group Treasury – and create the foundation for sound decisions in a dynamic market environment. You help us in modelling our client products and analysing customer behaviour, e. g. regarding prepayment rights in mortgage financing. Here, you critically question assumptions and methods, evaluate their impact on our risk profile, and contribute to the further development of our risk measurement and monitoring. You diligently assess interest rate risks as well as the suitability of hedging strategies and derivative investments. Through scenario analyses, stress tests and the critical review of models and assumptions, you play a key part in our independent risk monitoring. Of course, you always keep a close eye on market developments and support us in taking the right steps in challenging situations. As a part of the Second Line of Defence, you advise and challenge the First LoD, evaluate risk-relevant decisions and monitor compliance with market and liquidity risk limits. Your judgement ensures an equal assessment of opportunities and risks. Teamwork is key to success: You collaborate closely with colleagues from across the bank as well as the Head Office, develop group-wide standards and put them into practice. Your Profile Degree in Economics, Mathematics, Physics or a similar qualification Professional experience in a comparable position combined with strong capital markets expertise Ideally, experience in analysing and evaluating large data sets Excellent Python skills Ability to communicate complex topics clearly and tailor them to target audiences Analytical mindset, initiative and creativity Open to cultural diversity in an international environment Very good German and English, both written and spoken We offer many benefits Company pension plan, capital-building offers, free Deutschlandticket & bicycle leasING, company restaurant Hybrid working: In addition to working in the office, you can also work remotely – within operational, regulatory and legal requirements. Individualized work schedule models, sabbatical, subsidization of nursing & childcare costs Personal budget for continuing education and development as well as health; plus, a personal budget to set up your mobile working space Ready for a new job? At ING we are colourful and diverse: different personalities with different perspectives - an international culture where we value and appreciate each other. We believe in substance over style, people instead of labels. This describes you to a T? Simply apply online - your resume is all we need to get to know you, a cover letter is optional!

description: Please note this position is based in London and this will be the contractual location of the successful candidate, other locations cannot be considered. Senior Enhanced Index Portfolio Manager This is a great job for someone who has deep knowledge of passive equity investing with sophisticated quantitative and engineering capabilities. A bit about the job: We are seeking a highly experienced Enhanced Index Portfolio Manager to join our Portfolio Implementation & Investment Engineering team. With deep expertise in managing passively constructed equity beta solutions, the successful candidate will play a leading role in shaping the evolution of our Enhanced Index strategies, driving process innovation, and ensuring strong alignment between portfolio outcomes and investment intent. The Enhanced Equity business has experienced significant growth in AUM over the last 3 years to £65bn under management and expected to double over the next few years. The new addition to the team will combine deep knowledge of passive equity investing with quantitative and engineering capabilities, contributing to the design, optimisation, and day-to-day implementation of our strategies. As a senior practitioner, you will provide both thought leadership and hands-on portfolio management execution within a collaborative team environment. In this role, you will lead enhancements to our investment processes—refining models, strengthening portfolio construction, overseeing liquidity and cash equitisation, rebalancing, corporate actions, guideline compliance, and ongoing risk and performance monitoring. You will also drive index methodology and event analysis, translating changes such as additions, deletions, IPOs, free‑float adjustments, and sector reclassifications into proactive portfolio positioning and efficient implementation across mandates. Working closely with Investment Engineering and Trading, you will help design and industrialise scalable tools that improve risk management, liquidity assessment, portfolio construction, execution quality, and operational efficiency. Additionally, you will contribute to innovation across the wider investment platform by challenging established approaches and embedding best‑practice principles that support business growth through next‑generation automation. Skills and experience we’re looking for: Proven track record managing passive and enhanced‑index equity portfolios across regional and global markets, using advanced portfolio‑optimisation tools and an engineering mindset to deliver low‑risk equity beta solutions for clients. Deep understanding of equity instruments, trading mechanics, market microstructure, benchmark construction, index methodologies and end to end investment processes applied to managing large portfolios (>GBP 100bn). Confidence to challenge established processes constructively. Propose evidence-based improvements and ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear concepts for non-specialist stakeholders. Naturally inquisitive and innovative, with a passion for solving complex portfolio‑construction, implementation and trading challenges in a team‑based environment. What you’ll get for this role: Generous pension scheme - Aviva will contribute up to 14%, depending on what you put in Eligibility for annual performance bonus Family friendly parental and carer’s leave Generous holiday entitlement plus bank holidays with the option to buy/sell up to 5 additional days Up to 40% discount for Aviva products Aviva-funded Private Medical Benefit to help you get expert support when you need it Brilliant flexible benefits including electric cars Aviva Matching Share Plan and Save As You Earn scheme 21 volunteering hours per year In this role you’ll be ‘Certified’ under the Financial Conduct Authority / Prudential Regulation Authority’s Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SMCR). This means that we’ll need to complete some regulatory background checks on you before you take up your role and we’ll need to ask you some questions on an annual basis to make sure you remain ‘fit and proper’ and competent to carry out your role. We’ll provide training on what holding a SMCR role means when you join us and annually thereafter. Aviva is for everyone: We’re inclusive and welcome everyone – we want applications from all backgrounds and experiences. Excited but not sure you tick every box? title: Private Banking Assistant (Russian speaker)
description: A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Private Banking Assistant (Russian speaker) (80-100%) We are seeking a Private Banker Assistant to join our New Markets department in Zurich. This position is part of the Eastern Countries team . The successful candidate will become part of a dynamic and growing team, working closely with Private Bankers to deliver premium services to our private clients. YOUR ROLE Support Private Bankers in clients’, administrative and commercial activities, to ensure a service of excellence to a UHNW and HNW demanding clientele. Provide information to clients about their portfolios. Verify, process and place transfer and all market orders in the system as per client instructions, and follow up. Liaise with internal services to ensure timely and accurate execution/resolution of clients’ requests. Manage in an impeccable way account openings and proactively process and follow account openings, monitoring of the accounts, cash management, overdrafts. Proactively deal with all administrative tasks (filing/recording of documentation and KYC, FCRM alerts monitoring, documentation update etc.) in collaboration with Private Bankers. Prepare under the guidance of the Private Bankers, presentation material for client meetings and for business development activities. Deal with clients’ mailing. Support clients with on-line access. YOUR PROFILE Academic or commercial education in the financial field. Minimum 5 years’ experience in banking, in a similar role. Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite, in particular Excel and Powerpoint (follow-up of complex tables, creation of presentations and reports, etc.), ideally knowledge of the G2 in-house tool. Perfect command of Russian , as well as English and French/German. Very good knowledge of Private Banking services (Lombard Loans, Portfolio Management, Life Insurance, etc.) Pleasant personality, ability to integrate into an existing team and to work as part of a team, open-mindedness. Commercial spirit, and excellent presentation. Strong resistance to stress, ability to multi-task and prioritise workload. Strong sense of confidentiality. Domicile in Switzerland. Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication. As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy. It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.
